title: Initial configuration is reachable
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ on a Boolean input $x$, the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ is reachable from itself in the sense that some choice word produces a configuration with the same machine state, input-head position, work tapes, work-tape head positions, and output summary.
